name: Planet Pay payments
author: planetpaypayment

sections.description:
Planet Pay is a plugin that integrates with WooCommerce, providing additional payment methods such as credit card payments, BLIK, PayByLink, Google Pay, and Apple Pay. Customers are redirected to the Planet Pay gateway to complete their payments securely.

Features

  • Multiple payment methods: credit cards, BLIK, Google Pay, and more.
  • Easy installation and setup.
  • Supports test mode for sandbox environments.

Configuration

  1. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  2. Locate “Planet Pay” and click “Manage.”
  3. Fill in the required fields such as Merchant ID (MID), Secret, and API details.
  4. Enable test mode if needed and provide sandbox-specific credentials.

License

This plugin is distributed under the GPLv2 (or later) license. For more details, see License URI.

External Services

This plugin integrates with the PlanetPay API to process online payments, including BLIK, card transactions, and other payment methods.

Service Name: PlanetPay API
Purpose: Handles payment processing and transaction verification.
Data Sent:
– Order ID
– Transaction amount
– Customer details (only if required for processing)
– Merchant credentials (for authentication)

When Data is Sent:
– When a payment request is initiated.
– When verifying the payment status.

Where Data is Sent:
– Sandbox: https://api.sandbox.planetpay.pl/v1/ecommerce
– Production: https://api.planetpay.pl/v1/ecommerce

Terms of Service: PlanetPay Terms

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin file WooCommerce_planetpaypayment.zip.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click “Install Now.”
  4. Activate the plugin in Plugins → Installed Plugins.
sections.faq:
What WooCommerce version is supported?

The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce 6.5 or higher.

What PHP version is required?

PHP 7.4 or higher is required, with extensions: ext-curl and ext-json.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, this plugin is distributed under the GPLv2 license, allowing free use and modification.
